title: Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M via Ollama on a power-limited RTX 3090
slug_note: ollama pull of the unsloth GGUF, fully GPU-resident (23GB, 96% GPU / 4% CPU) on a downclocked 3090 at 90% power limit: ~40 tok/s by wall clock.

variation.quant_detail: Q4_K_M pulled through Ollama's HF bridge (hf.co/unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF:Q4_K_M)

engine.config: ollama pull hf.co/unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF:Q4_K_M; context capped at 131072 via a local 'qwen-capped-128k' tag; blobs 16.5GB + 928MB projector on a secondary drive; load ~19.5s.

steps.text: cap context via a Modelfile tag (num_ctx 131072) if you need the long window
